mission.posting: Get a copy of someone's medical record to settle an argument.

email.subject: Rod of Asclepius
email.body:
Hey,
So, I may or may not have gotten involved in a bit of an internet shout off with someone who's posting CLEARLY photoshopped pictures of... You know, it doesnt really matter, look, i need a legit medical record of this guy to settle it all in dramatic fashion. I'd get it myself but, uhh, I made those intentions pretty clear and, you know how CSEC is with stuff like that. Anyway, can you help me out? His name's "Jonas Sandburg" - the medical database has a tool to send records to people, could you flick a copy to "gila@jmail.com"
Thanks! -G

attachments.note: Guy i need a record of: "Jonas Sandburg" Address to email to: "gila@jmail.com"
